entities.summary: David Jonathan Hammond, better known as Didz Hammond, is an English bassist. He was the bassist and backing vocalist in The Cooper Temple Clause, and in Carl Barât's Dirty Pretty Things. The band's second album, Romance At Short Notice, saw Hammond taking on more vocal duties within the band, for example contributing all the vocals on the ballad "The North". He is also the bass player in Brett Anderson's live electric band. Before music, Didz made his trade as a stand up comedian in Reading.
